newsitem.title: USA: Premier and Fisher sign distribution deal.
newsitem.headline: Premier and Fisher sign distribution deal.

text.p: Premier Inc and the Fisher Scientific International Inc's Fisher HealthCare unit said Monday they signed a three-year agreement for the distribution of laboratory products.
Fisher HealthCare will provide diagnostic instruments, test materials and related clinical products as well as laboratory equipment, chemicals and other supplies to Premier members and affiliates.
Premier is a privately held company. It declined to disclosed financial information about the deal.
